adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` to call `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb), which performs a DB lookup via `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb). The migration creating `embeddable_hosts` does not add an index on `host` (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb), and the query uses `lower(host)` so even a plain index wouldn’t be used without a functional index. This introduces a per-request DB query on a public embed endpoint, representing a concrete performance/scalability concern compared to the previous in-memory `SiteSetting` check.
